    The family criterion with indicator cocycles #

    Proposition 7.9 for the selected binary family of the proof of Proposition 8.3: with A₀ ≅ kP through Θ, chosen indicator cocycles μ_i = μ_{E_i} of distinct classes satisfying the hypotheses of Theorem 7.7 and characters forming part of an integer basis, Corollary 7.8 gives a binary fibre isomorphic to A; by Proposition 11.3(3) the transported rays are a normed multiplicative basis and a ray transversal of A.

    The hypotheses on μ_i (relative, homogeneous, associative family, spanning) are taken as the FamilyHyp of Theorem 7.7; they are discharged where A₀, its gradings and the indicator classes are constructed.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
